sprint5_reference.label: Frozen Sprint 5 single-CV reference; not a matched 3-seed H1 baseline.

two_reporting_units_statement: Two reporting units are used: (a) three-seed H1 stacking mean±std; (b) frozen Sprint 5 single-CV base-model reference. These are not statistically matched quantities.
meta_evaluation_limitation: H1 Macro-F1 is computed by evaluating the meta-learner on the same OOF matrix used to train it. No separate meta-learner holdout exists under the current data-isolation rules. This is in-sample evaluation at the meta-learner level and is NOT a fully held-out end-to-end generalisation estimate.
scaling_limitation: SVM/NN OOF predictions use scaling statistics computed on the full frozen TRAIN, including rows in the OOF held-out fold. This is a bounded, label-independent leakage channel accepted for feature-space consistency.
